Bettina Kroll: the official change of ownership was **3 November 2025**.

- Moss's Coastal digest from Sun 2 Nov 2025 says "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03".
- Your own recap note (8 Dec 2025) also gives November 3 as the official handoff.

Your recap also says you kept running PHL day to day until 21 Nov for the terminal cutover, and that Kwame took over operationally on 22 Nov. If the tracker wants the date the account formally moved, use 3 Nov. If it wants the date Kwame started running it, use 22 Nov.
